Mark tag produces highlighted output

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>This is <mark>highlighted text</mark> in a sentence.</p>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result.content)
}
```
